public_rationale: The records make further borrowing plausible and show that debt is part of CoreWeave's expansion financing. They do not provide a complete funding bridge establishing that additional borrowing is required. The filing also identifies equity as a possible source. That qualification does not disprove the claim, but expected debt financing alone does not settle the stronger word 'needs.'
limitations: Reading the claim simply as an expectation of more borrowing would produce a different assessment.
The selected reporting period does not capture every financing transaction before publication.
Potential equity financing is not evidence that sufficient equity was actually committed.
